model_text: Septris combines two models. LightGBM, a decision-tree model, reads summaries of the last few hours. A masked temporal GRU, a deep-learning model, reads each patient's history hour by hour. Both scores are calibrated on one group of validation patients; the weight was then chosen on a second, separate group of validation patients: 20% LightGBM + 80% GRU.
